citations.claim: controlled body speed jumps after collision, driving huge velocity error
one step earlier speed was small, showing collision impulse caused the spike

counterfactual.change: Reduced controller kp from ~26.77 to 2.0 only; lower gain keeps velocity-error force below fmax after the same collision, so no violation.

explanation: At step 28 bodies 0 and 1 are touching (gap ~0.005). The fast intruder (speed ~35) collides with the controlled hover body, impulsively changing its velocity from speed ~2.9 to ~10.27 at step 29. The controller's velocity-error law (kp ~26.77 toward waypoint at limited vcmd) then demands ~486.9 N, far above fmax ~72.67, indicating the commanded force is not saturated/clamped to fmax after collision-induced error spikes.
vision_note: The small red body falls onto the larger blue controller-driven body, touching it at step 28. At step 29 the red body deflects to the left while the blue body is knocked to the right, away from the green waypoint.
